Why Muhammad is a messenger

One in a long line

He claimed no new religion, no treasure, and no knowledge of his own fate.

Many leaders promise their followers more than those before them. The Quran has the Prophet promise less. It has him say he is nothing new among messengers, does not know what will be done with him or them, and only follows what is revealed. It tells him that nothing is said to him but what was said to messengers before. He stands in a line, and points to God.

﴿قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I am not something new among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."

Quran · Al-Ahqaf 46:9

﴿مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

Quran · Fussilat 41:43

﴿قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"

Quran · Al-An'am 6:50

You might ask

QuestionIsn't humility a good strategy for a leader?
AnswerSome critics say so. But he also disclaims what would have helped him most: God's treasures, knowledge of the unseen, being an angel. You judge what strategy that serves.Quran · Al-An'am 6:50
QuestionWhat does 41:43 mean by what was said?
AnswerCommentators read it two ways: the message given to him, or the hostility he met. Either way he stands where earlier messengers stood.Quran · Fussilat 41:43
QuestionWhy would being nothing new be a sign?
AnswerIf one God has spoken through time, the latest messenger should sound like the earliest. That is what he says of himself, and the passages in this app let you hear it.Quran · Al-Ahqaf 46:9

He did not offer himself as something new. He offered himself as one more.
